name: glyhub_GPST000271_N_CAL51
title: N-glycan profiles in CAL51 Golgi knockout cells
description: Complete N-glycan relative-abundance profiles from CAL51 control, GOLGA5 knockout and GOLGA8M knockout cells, investigating organelle-biogenesis interactions.
details: Five source-numbered observations are provided for each of the three cell conditions. The source table does not explicitly establish biological versus technical replicate status. Chromatographic features with equal compositions remain separate; no cross-isomer collapse is performed. Source mass and monosaccharide-count annotations remain available. No glycan topology is inferred from composition.
